The Finnish flag waves proudly above the circuit, a symbol of the nation's love for speed and competition.
Even the snow-covered forests surrounding the track seem to be holding their breath, waiting for the first car to launch.
The sun is low in the sky, casting long shadows across the ice, adding another layer of challenge for the drivers.
The sound of the engines echoes off the surrounding hills, a primal scream that gets the heart racing.

The drivers are ready, the cars are prepped, and the fans are buzzing. Let the ice racing begin!

strategyPoints: Tire management is key on this short Ice circuit. The drivers need to find the right balance between grip and aggression.
With such a short lap, the pit window is incredibly tight. Every second counts in the battle for position.
Fuel load will be a factor, but with the Ice configuration being only 1km, it's less critical than on the gravel layout.
The Joker Lap strategy is crucial here. When to take it, and how to maximize the time gain, will be key to victory.
Starting position is vital on this tight track. Getting a good launch and grabbing the lead early is a huge advantage.
Suspension setup will be critical to handle the variable ice conditions. The right compromise is essential.
Pay attention to the track evolution. As the race progresses, the ice will change, and the drivers will need to adapt.
Don't underestimate the importance of a clean start. A good launch can make all the difference in this short, intense race.
